final: WITH g AS (SELECT production_type_code AS code, AVG(unit_price) AS avg_price FROM Products GROUP BY production_type_code), o AS (SELECT AVG(avg_price) AS overall_avg FROM g WHERE avg_price IS NOT NULL) SELECT g.code, g.avg_price, g.avg_price - o.overall_avg AS diff FROM g CROSS JOIN o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND g.avg_price IS NOT NULL AND g.avg_price > o.overall_avg ORDER BY (g.avg_price - o.overall_avg) IS NULL, (g.avg_price - o.overall_avg) DESC LIMIT 10
